subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-authored configuration actions from SKILL.md frontmatter, and what URL/action trust contract should the dashboard enforce?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically bounded, but accepting skill-provided dashboard links changes public skill metadata and authenticated UI trust semantics, which cleanup automation cannot decide safely.

options.title: Approve Typed Config Action
options.body: Add a generic skill configuration action with shared URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

options.title: Keep Existing Link Surfaces
options.body: Keep `homepage`, Skill Cards, and ClawHub pages as the supported configuration-discovery paths for now.

options.title: Prototype Outside Core First
options.body: Let ClawHub, Skill Cards, or plugin dashboard metadata carry configuration links first, then add a core dashboard action only after the trust model settles.

recommendation.title: Approve Typed Config Action
recommendation.body: Add a generic skill configuration action with shared URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the current Skills page and shared Control UI URL-safety surface, which recent history routes through shakkernerd's Control UI refactor work.
